SELECT t.id, t.teacher_no AS teacherNo, t.name, t.gender, t.phone, t.email, t.college_id AS collegeId, c.college_name AS collegeName, u.username, u.status, t.create_time AS createTime FROM t_teacher t LEFT JOIN t_college c ON c.id = t.college_id LEFT JOIN t_user u ON u.ref_id = t.id AND u.user_type = 'TEACHER'
AND (t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.teacher_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND t.college_id = #{collegeId}
ORDER BY t.id

t.id IN
